algorithms.name: DP-TT (Differentially Private Top Two, EB-TCI-beta with GPE_eta(epsilon) and GLR stopping)

symbols.T_star_eps: private characteristic time T*_eps(nu), inverse = sup_w inf_{kappa in Alt} sum_a w_a d_eps(nu_a, kappa_a), with d_eps = inf_phi {eps TV(nu,phi) + KL(phi,kappa)}

conditions: algorithm is delta-correct and epsilon-global DP on Bernoulli instances
instance has a unique best arm

source.label: thm:lower_bound

results.notes: Non-asymptotic; holds for all epsilon, delta. Theorem 4 additionally gives T*_eps >= sum_a 1/Delta_{eps,a}.

conditions: Bernoulli instances with a unique best arm
tuning: GLR stopping rule with threshold c(n,eps,delta)=c_1(n,delta)+c_2(n,eps) as in Eq. (thresholds)

source.label: thm:correctness
source.quote: Given any sampling rule using the GPE_{\eta}(\epsilon), using the GLR stopping rule as in Eq.~\eqref{eq:GLR_stopping_rule} with the GPE_{\eta}(\epsilon) and the stopping threshold $c(n, \epsilon, \delta) \eqdef c_{1}(n, \delta) + c_{2}(n, \epsilon)$ ... yields a $\delta$-correct and $\epsilon$-global DP algorithm for all Bernoulli instances with a unique best arm.

results.notes: Correctness guarantee P(stop and wrong answer) <= delta for any sampling rule using GPE; recorded with DP-TT as the algorithm. Also epsilon-global DP.

symbols.eta_grid: geometric grid parameter eta > 0 of the GPE estimator
symbols.T_star_eps_beta: beta-characteristic time: T*_eps with the constraint w_{a*} = beta

conditions: Bernoulli instance with distinct means in (0,1)^K
tuning: beta in (0,1); with (eta,beta)=(1,1/2) the bound is 4 T*_{eps,1/2} <= 8 T*_eps

source.label: thm:asymptotic_upper_bound
source.quote: Let $(\epsilon, \delta, \eta, \beta) \in \R_{+}^{\star} \times (0,1) \times \R_{+}^{\star} \times (0,1)$ and $c$ as in Eq.~\eqref{eq:thresholds}. The DP-TT algorithm is $\epsilon$-global DP, $\delta$-correct and satisfies that, for any Bernoulli instance $\bnu$ with distinct means $\mu \in (0,1)^{K}$, \[ \limsup_{\delta \to 0} \frac{\bE_{\bm \nu \pi}\left[\tau_{\epsilon,\delta}\right]}{\log (1 / \delta)} \le 2(1+\eta)T^{\star}_{\epsilon,\beta}(\boldsymbol{\nu}) \: . \]

results.notes: Asymptotic in delta, holds for any epsilon. Lemma (inversion_GLR_stopping_rule) gives the same bound for any sampling rule converging to the beta-optimal allocation.
